mechanism: Both drugs cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypomagnesemia, hypocalcemia); foscarnet may inhibit voriconazole metabolism via CYP450, increasing voriconazole levels.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially magnesium and calcium), and voriconazole levels closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation.
